defects.summary: A finalizing journal whose success lock was never committed advertised only resume; resume failed with 'rollback or manual review is required' and rollback was not the advertised action.
defects.fix: Journal advertises rollback only until the lock is durable and verified; find_incomplete_transaction and resume classify the live lock against previous_lock_sha256/result_lock_sha256 (FinalizationLock).
